newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate down on high supply.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate down on high supply.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate dropped 90 basis points to 10.9 percent on Tuesday as supply exceeded demand and most banks had replenished funds after a Christmas shortage.
Dealers said settlements totalled 30.6 million kuna against 95 million kuna on offer. Of this, 20 million were fresh borrowings.

Call money rate was steady at 11 percent, but most short-term deals were struck at 10.5 percent. One longer-term placement was made at 15 percent. Insurers chareged a steady nine percent for old loans.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Wednesday at 5.5345 against the dollar and 3.5603 to the German mark. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom. 385-1-4557075
